problem: A GTM lead weighing entry into a new EU market has no fast, evidence-backed way to see whether that country's public sector buys what they sell, who buys it, and who wins those contracts — $tender-demand-scan turns the official TED procurement feed into a scored, sourced market-entry signal report.

skills.role: Queries the live TED API for a product and EU country, computes a deterministic 0-100 demand signal, and writes the sourced HTML market-entry report
